title: China travel budget hacks tips for family travelling with kids? Read here.. 🇨🇳✨
description:
China travel budget hacks tips..
🇨🇳✨

Ever feel like family travel in China is going to drain your bank account before the trip even starts?

Flights. Hotels. Theme parks. Food.
It adds up FAST. 😩

We felt that too before our first big China family adventure. I remember staring at hotel prices thinking… how are families doing this without going broke?

So instead of giving up, we started asking better questions.

What if we travel during shoulder season instead of peak holidays?
What if we stay near metro lines instead of tourist hotspots?
What if we book hotels that include breakfast so we save on one full meal a day?
What if we use high speed trains instead of flights between cities?

Those questions changed everything.

On one of our trips, we booked a hotel slightly outside the city center but right beside a metro station. The room was half the price, breakfast was included, and the train got us to major attractions in minutes. Our kids thought the subway ride was part of the adventure anyway. 🚆

Here’s a fun trivia for you…

China has the largest high speed rail network in the world. Over 40,000 kilometers of track. That means families can travel between major cities faster and often cheaper than flying. It is one of the reasons multi city trips in China are so doable for families.

Another little secret?

Many hotels in China are family friendly and will upgrade you if you politely ask or email ahead. We’ve received welcome fruit platters, kids slippers, even themed rooms just because we asked kindly. 🍎

Travel does not have to mean luxury spending.
It means smart planning.
It means choosing memories over stress.

And when your kids are jumping on the hotel bed laughing in a new country… you’ll realize the best investment was the experience, not the price tag. 🤍
